description: This PHP source file defines a class `ViewExportcustomizations` that extends `SugarView` and is responsible for rendering the export customizations view within the SuiteCRM/ SugarCRM module builder. It includes methods for rendering the page and retrieving module title parameters, utilizes Smarty for templating, and interacts with other components like `AjaxCompose` and `MBPackage` to facilitate the export customization feature.

classes.name: ViewExportcustomizations
classes.description: A view class for exporting customizations in the module builder, extending `SugarView` and providing display and title parameter functions.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Retrieves and returns the module title parameters for display, including the module name and title.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the export customizations interface by preparing data, assigning variables to Smarty, and outputting the assembled AJAX section.
